# Berkeley SoftFloat 3e — vendored

This directory contains a pinned copy of Berkeley SoftFloat 3e (BSD-3 license — see `LICENSE`).

- Upstream: https://github.com/ucb-bar/berkeley-softfloat-3
- Upstream commit: see `UPSTREAM_SHA`
- Used **only in testbenches** via Verilator DPI. Not instantiated in synthesisable RTL.
